transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling severely depressed and completely drained of energy for over two years now. I've lost all interest in the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy, and I just can't find the motivation to do anything anymore.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, high, or needing very little sleep?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods where I felt unusually energetic, high, or needed very little sleep.
Have you ever heard voices, seen things others couldn't, or had strong beliefs that others found unusual, especially during times when you weren't feeling depressed?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I have never heard voices, seen things that weren't there, or held any unusual beliefs. Those kinds of things have never happened to me.
During these past two years, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where you felt like your normal self and your depression completely went away?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. These feelings of depression have been completely constant and continuous for the entire two years and three months. I haven't felt like my normal self even for a single day.
During this difficult time, have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or suicide?

Yes, I often wish I wouldn't wake up, and I get recurring thoughts of wanting to die. I've also had sudden, strong urges to jump from high places, made specific plans on how to do it, and have even attempted to end my life.
Along with the low energy, have you also been struggling with things like low self-esteem, trouble concentrating, or feelings of hopelessness?

Yes, I constantly feel completely useless and like I have absolutely no value at all. My mind also gets exhausted so quickly whenever I try to focus or think deeply about anything. It just feels impossible to concentrate.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite during these past two years?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep patterns or my appetite over this period. They seem to have stayed pretty much the same.
Have you or those close to you noticed that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or on the other hand, that you are unusually restless and unable to sit still?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't think I'm moving or speaking any slower, and I haven't felt unusually restless either.
Before these past two years of severe depression, did you generally feel like your normal self, or have you struggled with a milder, low-grade sadness for many years?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought much about whether I had a milder sadness before all of this. But I know for certain that these severe, overwhelming feelings definitely started about two years and three months ago.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or do you regularly use any medications, alcohol, or other substances?
No, I don't have any diagnosed medical conditions and I don't take any regular medications. I also don't regularly use alcohol or any other substances.
